title: NumberLine
author: DeepBuild
description: NumberLine as one scale@1 and one axis@1 whose ticks follow the one tick rule, a path tip, and numbers as text@1 in the math role, or labels as vector@1 items, placed onto their ticks. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

length.about: the line's length in units; 0 for (max − min) × unit_size

unit_size.about: units per number, when no length is written

include_tip.about: an arrow tip at the line's max end

label_direction.about: the side the numbers sit on

labels.about: labels: [[value, item ID]] of vector@1 items placed onto their ticks, as {value → vector ID}

move_to.about: move_to: the line's center, in units

color.about: the line's and ticks' color; unwritten, the ink role

stroke_width.about: the line's width, w × unit ÷ 100 u

tick_size.about: a tick's half length in units, each way across the line

longer_tick_multiple.about: an elongated tick's length over a tick's

numbers_with_elongated_ticks.about: the numbers whose ticks are longer

include_numbers.about: whether each tick shows its number

numbers_to_exclude.about: the numbers shown with no label

font_size.about: the numbers' font size: an em of font_size ÷ 96 units

line_to_number_buff.about: the gap from the line to a number, in units (MED_SMALL_BUFF)

decimal_places.about: the places each number shows; −1 for the places its step needs

refuses.rotation: Leave it out: a number line lies flat; turn the shot's camera, or use math.axes for an upright one.
refuses.scaling: Leave it out: math@1 axes are linear; for a log axis write scale@1 with type log.
refuses.decimal_number_config: Write decimal_places instead: the numbers' other formatting is the look's.
refuses.label_constructor: Leave it out: numbers are text@1 in the math role, or give labels as vector@1 items.
refuses.exclude_origin_tick: Leave it out: every step has its tick; leave a number off with numbers_to_exclude.
refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
